claims.evidence: Witness photos show visible wear/scratches, paint fading, and surface rust/paint wear on the metal body.
Brand/model nameplate details are not readable in the provided witness report.
No photo/clip shows it powering on, running, or demonstrating stitch/motor performance.
Photos show the machine and foot pedal area, but do not confirm included accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, attachments) or completeness.
No manual is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No service records or internal inspection evidence is shown.

risks.risk: Motor may not run smoothly or may have weak speed control; stitch performance could be poor even if the machine looks intact.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine powering on, running at low and high speed, and sewing a straight line on fabric (showing the needle moving consistently).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a vintage sewing machine with untested motor/stitching (assume possible non-working or poor performance).

risks.risk: Missing or incorrect internal parts (bobbin case, timing, feed mechanism) could prevent proper stitching.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the bobbin/bobbin case area opened and installed correctly, plus a close-up of the feed/timing area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown internal condition (assume parts may be missing or timing may be off).

risks.risk: Power/connection issues (faulty switch, damaged wiring, belt/pulley problems) could make it unusable.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing the power switch, cable connection, and a belt/pulley close-up while running (or a test showing it starts reliably).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified electrical condition (assume it may need repair).

risks.risk: Rust and paint wear may indicate longer-term neglect; moving parts may be stiff or noisy.
risks.proof: Video showing handwheel movement smoothly and the machine running without excessive noise/smoke, plus close-ups of rusted areas.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic-wear affecting usability (assume it may require cleaning/lubrication).

risks.risk: Brand/model cannot be confirmed; Japanese claim may be false, affecting resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand/model nameplate or any stamped markings on the machine head and cabinet.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic vintage sewing machine (no premium for Japanese make).

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (presser feet, bobbins, needles, attachments), reducing usefulness.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included accessory with counts (foot pedal, power cable, presser feet set, bobbins, needles, attachments) and a photo showing they fit the machine.
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine-only or minimal accessories (assume missing attachments).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the brand/model nameplate/stamp on the machine head and cabinet.
Record a short video: power on, run at low and high speed, and sew a straight line on fabric.
Show the bobbin case/bobbin area open and installed correctly (clear photos).
Show the power switch and cable connection, and a belt/pulley close-up (and confirm it runs without slipping).
List and photograph all accessories included (presser feet, bobbins, needles, attachments, manual) with counts.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a vintage-style sewing machine mounted on a wooden cabinet/table, so it can be priced at its worst-case based on visible wear and untested functionality; seller claims about perfect condition, Japanese make, and smooth motor are not proven by the report.
